## Standing operator rules
- Any new secret reference in config/secrets.yaml must use vault://ledgerly/<ENV>/<KEY> and never an environment-variable placeholder.
- Never enable a new Celery task in ledgerly/tasks/ unless perf/locust_tasks.py demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.
- I’m stepping into a meeting for an hour, carry on with what you were doing.

## Current objective
Fix the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py` double-counting refunds. The earlier Tenacity refactor is superseded until next sprint.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Wrapping webhook handlers in a retry decorator with 5 attempts caused duplicate customer emails.

## Recent work
Completed worker retention and payload-alias cleanup: removed `BillingWorker._last_batch`; 41 worker tests and the full suite passed (118 passed, 7 skipped). A 5,000-batch reproduction peaked at 7.3 MiB, settled at 2.1 MiB, and left no pending events.

Webhook v2 cutover reached step 5: deployed `webhook:v2.8.1`, switched the public service selector, and created `webhook-replay-a`; replay logs still need checking. Deduplicated CLI billing filters with `_add_billing_filters(parser)`, fixed explicit `dest="currency"`, and updated an obsolete test assertion. All 37 CLI/command tests pass, and help now has one currency option. Latest command, `ruff check ledgerly/cli.py tests/test_cli.py`, found two E501 violations in `ledgerly/cli.py` at lines 117 and 203.
